Question 1
?

Given the curve r(t)=⟨2t2,et,2et⟩, find all of the points at which r′(t) and r(t) are parallel.

a
(1,1,2) and (8,e2,2e2)
b
(0,1,1) and (8,e2,2e2)
c
(0,1,2) and (8,e,2e)
d
(0,1,2) and (8,e2,2e2)
e
(0,1,1) and (4,e,2e)
